capabilities: Chat with DeepSeek Harness from a streaming chat panel with stop and retry
Display collapsible thinking blocks and tool-call cards with permission prompts
Inject note paths, full note content or vault root into the conversation context
Reuse DSH Web API key and base URL automatically for zero-config setup
Fork conversations, attach notes and export or import settings and chat history
extras: The README is bilingual (Simplified Chinese / English); it documents known limitations (sessions are not reloaded after plugin restart, 'always allow' permissions depend on server support, thinking visibility depends on the ACP server) and warns that `dsh --profile acp` does not load the ACP server — a separate bin command is required. Installation is manual (copy main.js/manifest.json/styles.css into the plugins folder).
motivation: The README doesn't state why the author built it.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to talk to a locally installed DeepSeek Harness agent over the Agent Client Protocol.

requires.name: DeepSeek Harness (dsh) with an ACP profile
DeepSeek API key (auto-read from DSH Web when left empty)

summary: An ACP bridge that lets you chat with DeepSeek Harness inside Obsidian, with streaming replies, thinking blocks and tool calls.
